content.text: Welcome to the Gold Temple world!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Duxedo you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
There you are! I was expecting you to arrive!
My name is Chef Bernardo. I am the chef from SUMSUM.
I run all operations here for SUMSUM.
Oh look it is snack time for SUMSUM's pet at the jail!|Sorry I need to hurry now!
The last time I brought his snack too late,|he ate one of the guards.
All hail to our new king SUMSUM!
We serve our new King SUMSUM or|else we get eaten by his pet!
Did the chef bring the snack on time to SUMSUM's|pet? I don't want to be next to get eaten.
Guards! Keep on questioning our prisoners!|We need those answers!
Boris, we tried to get the answers out of|that archaeologist DR SWAN! But she|is not telling us the secret yet.
Try the other guy that we locked up in the jail!|Maybe Ferguson can tell us more!|He works for DR SWAN.
The guards will get the secret out of Ferguson soon!
That Ferguson guy was not telling us anything.|But Mister Pumpkin will give up the secret!!
Mister Pumpkin seems to look very scared when|SUMSUM's pet get near him!
It looks like we found mister Pumpkin's weak spot!|The secret will be mine soon!
So this is the gold temple.
I have dreamed about finding this place all my life.
But if this place is under SUMSUM's control.|That means we are in big trouble!
It seems everyone here is under SUMSUM's|spell when they have the red eyes.
We need to find out why my brother|has those prisons locked up.
What is the secret that is trying|to get out of his prisoners?
I will convince the elite team to get back in my team,| so we can stop Boris and SUMSUM!
Luckily I was just on time to feed SUMSUM's pet!
He was about to eat that guard!
No worries! I am still alive.|He only took a bite out of my shoe.
I will make sure SUMSUM's pet gets|another tasty snack!
The door to the jail room opens in a secret way.|No peeking!
Amazing! What a discovery!|Did you just see that?
I have been traveling around the world|to find ancient buildings.
Finally after following many clues|I was able to find this ancient building.
It seems this ancient building is full|with secret entrances.
I figured out how to open the door in front of us.
Did you notice that all the torches are on,|except those next 3 torches.
If only there was a way to set|those torches on fire?
I think I have an idea!
Could you do a battle against me|with strong fire Dynamons?
Yes! It worked! The flames from our fire|type Dynamons hit that torch!
Guards! They figured out how to|open the secret door!
Guards! Stop them! Or I will feed you to SUMSUM's pet!
Get away from that torch!
If this one gets on fire,|I will get eaten by SUMSUM's pet!
YIPE! I need to run and get away quickly!|I am too young to get eaten by SUMSUM's pet!
Great work! We got the second torch on fire!
I will catch that guard later.
There is only 1 man that can stop you now!
BORIS, take care of this boy!
I thought you would never ask.|I have a score to settle with the boy!
You might have figured out|how to light those torches on fire.
But I have a brilliant plan on how|to stop your Dynamons!
What? How is that possible? I used water type|Dynamons to avoid the fire reaching that last torch!
Boss! Great news.|We got the secret out of Mister Pumpkin!
Excellent work guard. I will notify SUMSUM|of this great news. See you around boy.
Boy! Please help me!|They locked me up in this jail
Guard! Lock up the boy!|We will put him also in jail!
I will defeat the boy and lock him up in jail!
What just happened there?|How did you get my jail key?
You idiot guard! You let the boy take your key!
Great work! Please use the key|to open my jail door!
Use the key in the jail|lock to set me free.
Thank you so much for helping|me to get out of this jail.
Ferguson was helping with my research|on ancient dinosaurs.
He was doing some digging and he found some ancient|dinosaur bone from a Tyceratox dynamon.
Ferguson brought the dinosaur bone toto me.|But then something happened!
Boris stole the Tyceratox bone from us|and locked up both me and Ferguson in jail.
I don't understand how it is possible that|there is a Tyceratox dinosaur in this room?
Did that dino come back from the dinosaur|extinction from just a bone?
Maybe Ferguson knows more?|Please also help to set him free.
Boy, over here! That guard in|front of me has the jail key!
Guard! Dr. Swan just escaped!|Do something!
No need to worry Chef Bernardo! I got this!
I did it!... I almost won!
You idiot! You mean you lost!|Look he even took your jail key!
Boy, you did it! Please set me free!
Use the key and set me free!
Ferguson, are you alright?
Dr. Swan, they tried to get the secret digging|location out of me where I found the bone!
And you did not tell the guards|the secret right?
Well... uuuhmm... I might have told the location to|Mister Pumpkin as I was bored in this jail and I|had to tell someone about it.
Oh no! I heard the guards saying that|they got the secret out of mister pumpkin!
I do have some good news! The guards threw away|my items here in the jail from my backpack.
The guards thought I had a normal discatch|in my backpack. But look it was a special discatch|that Dr.Swan made in the research tent.
You brought my special discatch from the|research tent? That just gives me an idea!
That Tyceratox Dynamon in front of us is|infected by hate. But a special discatch would turn|it back to normal!
Great idea! But the special discatch|only works when Tyceratox is weak|and almost out of health.
Boy, we remember the hero you were|when you caught Zenix with a special discatch.|Do you think you are brave enough to do it again?
Guard! We cannot let them have that last key!
But how can we outsmart the boy?
Tyceratox, I brought you tasty snack!|You can eat that guard!
What? You are going to let Tyceratox eat me?
It is the perfect solution!|He will also eat the key from the guard!
Noooooooo...
Boy, you need to stop Tyceratox! Remember to|use the special discatch only when he is low on health!
This won't work, Tyceratox is too powerful.|We must wait and use special discatch
No, not yet. It is not weak enough, it will only fail.
Now is your chance,|use the new discatch to capture Tyceratox!
Boy, you did it!|Tyceratox turned back to a normal Dynamon!
We can use Tyceratox to stop Boris and SUMSUM!
But Dr. Swan what about the key?|Tyceratox ate that guard!
What? You mean me? I was inside|the belly from Tyceratox for a moment!
He spit me out! I guess I taste really bad.|I did not take a bath for a month.
Please take this key! I am getting out of here!
Ewwwhhhh the key is covered with stinky slime now.|I am not touching that.
Boy, could you use that slimy key|and free Mister Pumpkin?
Oh no look! What happened to mister|pumpkin! His pumpkin mask looks damaged.
I can see who is under the Mister|Pumpkin mask! The person under the Pumpkin mask is...
Mister Pumpkin don't worry!|We will get you out of jail!
Mister Pumpkin are you all right?|Did they hurt you?
Look! Now I see it clearly!|Mister Pumpkin is a man!
That Tyceratox Dynamon took a bite|out of my Pumpkin mask!
I am so sorry! I thought Tyceratox would eat me|and I told the secret location from the research tent.
Mister Pumpkin are you...
Yes it is me, Maxwell the town mayor|from the Christmas Town.
In order to protect my town I had to keep|Klaude and his elites distracted with quests.
I thought the zombie virus would stop Klaude|for sure in the Halloween world.
Unfortunately Boris daughter was immune against|the zombie virus, so they were able to make|an antidote and stop my great plan.
And now I only made it worse as I told|the guards the research tent was hidden|behind the trees in the Gold City.
That means Boris and his guards will be|able to dig up more dinosaur bones!
And SUMSUM will be able to revive the|dinosaur from the bone and infect it with hate.
We need to prepare ourselves to fight|against another infected by hate Dinosaur soon!
We will need another special discatch.|Give me some time to create another one!
Also if we can catch another golden dinosaur|with a special discatch, we will have a bigger chance|to defeat SUMSUM.
Please be careful! Chef Bernardo put the|gold temple full with booby traps.
You are starting to irritate me boy!|You made SUMSUM lose his Tyceratox pet!
Luckily Boris already found a new dinosaur bone.|Thanks to scaredy pants Mister Pumpkin hahah.
I have a very fitting choice for my first|and last Dynamon for battle to remind|Mister Pumpkin about something.
Did you see that Pumpkin that still had|...a face! Whahah!
That is so mean! Chef Bernardo tried to|diss me by showing a pumpkin twice|in battle.
One day I will get my revenge Chef Bernardo!
I got to go now! I need to prepare new|tasty snacks for SUMSUM's new pet!
Try and reach my kitchen if you dare!
What? How did you manage|to get over those spikes?
I dare you to make it to the other side!|Are you fast enough to survive those spikes!
Ouch! That spike just hit me!
What is that sound?|I just heard a terrifying scream!
That is the sound of SUMSUM's new pet Tyrexar!
Thanks again for giving us the secret location|mister Pumpkin! My guards were able to dig up a|Tyrexar dinosaur bone.
I can't believe it. I had 1 weak|moment and now Boris already has the|dinosaur bone.
It gets even better! SUMSUM already revived|Tyrexar and now he is infected with hate!| Whahahah!
Let me think. I got 2 choices here.|Either I get eaten by SUMSUM's new pet or...
Or... I make a run for it and get out of this place!|RUN!!!!!!!! Mommy I am coming home!
That guard is such a coward!
Boy, I have good news!|I finished making a new special discatch!
That looks like is worth a lot!|I will steal that from you!
Give me back that special discatch!|We need it!
I just sold that special discatch to Ruby.|She gave me a lot of coins for it!
Boy, we need to get that special discatch!
Ruby, we need have that special discatch back!
You mean this special discatch thing? That|guard just sold it to me for a very fair price.
I tell you what. I am willing to trade|it with you for level up snack!
Boy, do you still have some|level up snacks left from the shop?
It was a pleasure doing business with you.
What a relief! I am so happy we|got the special discatch back.
Oh you got that special discatch again.|Maybe I can steal it from you again!
Boy, guard that special discatch!|Don't let that guard steal it!
Great work! That guard was not able|to steal the special discatch this time!
Interesting. So you found a way to stop SUMSUM's|pets by using a special discatch.
That does not worry me.|I will tell you why after this battle.
I know what Dr. Swan uses as a special ingredient|to turn a normal discatch into a special discatch!
My guards followed Dr. Swan to her secret location|where she got the special ingredient!
We took that supply of special ingredients.|Dr. Swan will not be able to make|more special discatches!
Oh no! We are in trouble! Without the special ingredient|I can't make more special discatches!
I just gave Tyrexar a lot of powered up snacks!
This will make him much harder to defeat than Tyceratox!
Watch out not to get eaten by Tyrexar|whahaha!
Boy, you need to stop Tyrexar! Remember to|use the special discatch only when he is low on health!
This won't work, Tyrexar is too powerful.|We must wait and use special discatch
No, not yet. It is not weak enough, it will only fail.
Now is your chance,|use the new discatch to capture Tyrexar!
Boy, you did it! Tyrexar turned|back to a normal Dynamon!
You irritating boy!|I will quickly escape through the kitchen door!
Don't expect to reach SUMSUM so easily!|I placed a lot more booby traps!
I can't make a new special discatch|without the special ingredient!
Ferguson, could you please check in the|Treasure cave if the special ingredient is still there?
Give me me a moment!|I will be right back!
Do you also smell that? The chef|is baking a pie.
The special ingredient is a pink flower|that only grows on the leaves from|the cherry blossom tree.
During my research I saw a legendary Dynamon|eat a cherry blossom flower and it made|him fall asleep.
I merged that ingredient with a normal|discatch to make a special discatch.
Maybe if I defeat you, the chef|will give me a piece of that delicious pie!
Dr. Swan, I just returned from the|treasure cave!
Please tell me you found a cherry blossom flower.
Dr. Swan, the cherry blossom tree it is...
...all empty! There is not even a|single leaf on the tree anymore.
What?!!!! That whole tree was full|with cherry blossom flowers!
I can only make a special discatch|with 4 cherry blossom flowers.
Oh look the pie is ready!
Boris was in a hurry. He found a new|dinosaur bone for SUMSUM.
Boris said I had to get rid of the|cherry blossom flowers for him.
But that smell from the cherry blossom|flowers. As a chef I just could not resist it.
It turned out this ingredient|tastes amazing in a pie!
Selling these rare cherry blossom pies will|make me rich!
I am already sold out! My cherry blossom|pies were a big success!
Oh look at the time! I need to rush to|SUMSUM's new pet and bring him a welcome snack.
Dr. Swan, I just got an idea!
I am so luckily! I was able to buy|the first cherry blossom pie!
Boy, we need to get that pie from this guard!
No way! You are not getting my delicious pie!
How dare you to take my pie! I did|not even take 1 bite from it yet!
Dr. Swan, I have theory. The pie still|contains the cherry blossom flower.
What if we would merge 4 pies with|a normal discatch?
Ferguson you are genius!|I think that would work!
Boy, we need 3 more cherry blossom pies.
I wonder who else bought the pies from the chef?
Chuk, what are you doing here?
The chef said cherry blossom pie is|full of protein for my muscles!
I just bought 2 pies!
I just ate 1 full... pie...
This pie... is making...|me... feel... sleepy.
Look Chuk just fell asleep! |I think we can borrow 1 pie from Chuk right?
Great work! Now we only need 2 more pies.|Who else bought the pies?
Chuk! Wake up!
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZzzzzzz.....
Chuk! Ferguson just stole 1 cherry blossom|pie from you!
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZzzzzzz.....
I will get my revenge on you for stealing|the pie from my boyfriend Chuk!
Please calm down Jenni. I can explain it!
No need to worry anymore. I made a deal with Jenni!
Fergusson, it was a pleasure doing business with you.
Fergusson, what deal did you make?
I promised I would cook for|Jenni and Chuk for 7 days long.
hahah Fergusson you are full of surprises!
I came all the way over here|for the special pie from the Chef!
I saved up 1 week of salary|just to buy this special pie!
Where did my pie go?|I must have lost it.
I am so hungry! I will eat anything right now!
Look there are 2 pieces of meat on that table!
FRESH MEAT!!!!!! I will steal those!|That meat is mine hahah!
Good work boy. The mercenary did|not noticed we took that pie from him.
The mercenary is too busy eating the|meat. We only need 1 more pie to make|the special discatch.
I bought this special pie from the chef.| He said it was the last pie.
Ruby, we really need that last pie!
No Ruby, I really need that last pie! I want to|surprise my girlfriend Samantha with this pie!
It seems we have 2 people who|want to make a bid for the special pie.
As it seems to be rare I am willing to trade|it for the one who is willing to offer me|4 level up snacks!
What? 2 level up snacks!!!!??|Give me some time to get those!
Boy, do you think we can get 2 level up|snacks before Fredrik returns?
Ruby, I just returned and got 2 level up snacks.
Sorry Fredrik. I just sold the cherry|blossom pie to Dr. Swan and the boy.
Luckily you Dr. Swan! I guess I will have|to find a different surprise for my girlfriend.
Boy, please bring the 4 pies to me.|I will make a new special discatch!
Fredrik...
What is this voice that I hear?
Listen to my voice...Give in to the hate...
That pie should have been mine!
You need that pie for your girlfriend!
Boy! You are going... |TO GIVE ME ALL THOSE PIES!
Those pies belong to me and Samantha!
Fredrik! Stop this!|SUMSUM is taking over your mind.
Fredrik, leave the boy.|I have a more important task for you.
Yes master SUMSUM.|I am on my way!
SUMSUM took control over Fredrik!
Let's worry about that later.|We first need to make that special discatch.
It is time to try out the theory from Ferguson|to make a special discatch from those|4 cherry blossom pies.
I am sure my theory will work! Those|pies are full with cherry blossom flowers!
Ferguson! You are a genius!|Your theory worked!
Really? It worked?
I mean ofcourse it worked!
This will allow us to stop any infected|by hate Dynamon that SUMSUM|will use against us!
I am back! The elite team agreed to join my|team again on 1 condition.
Don't forget about our deal Klaude!
I promised the Elite team they can have|the gold treasure from SUMSUM's throne.
The elite team is going to be rich!
And I will have my revenge on my brother Boris!
What is this room? I recognize that|statue! No this can't be true?
Fire Elite, quickly we need to get Dom over here!|He knows more about this statue!
You got it boss! I will get him right now!
Klaude, I found Dom!
I can't believe it! You found the Gold Temple.
Dom, look at the statue! That statue sounds like a|story you have told me when I was a child.
A long... long time ago the gold temple was|guarded by the Golden Elite and his Legendary|Dynamon Knightanyx.
But the Golden Elite got old and|eventually he died of old age.
Knightanyx could not understand why|his master left him and he was so sad!
Knightanyx put on the armor from his master.|And he swore to protect the gold temple!
Dom, do you remember how Knightanyx|looked before he put on his amor?
Knightanyx was a golden lion.|His hair was made out of golden flames!
These statues must have been|placed here to scare people away.
They are a warning that Knightanyx is|the guardian of the Gold Temple!
Anyone who enters the gold temple|will be avenged by Knightanyx!
Come on Dom! You think some story about|a Knightanyx statue is going to scare me away!
Sounds like Electric Elite is scared again hahah.
No way! Nothing will ever scare me again!
Look one of those Knightanyx statues just moved!
What? Where? No that|can't be true right?
Yes I also saw it! That Knightanyx statue just moved!
Klaude, we are in trouble! That statue is alive!
Did that statue just came to life?|But how? Could it be Knightanyx?
I have a plan how we can defeat Knightanyx.|But we can only do it with the help from the boy!
Boy, I know you found a way|to make new special discatch.
You will not be able to use it|when Knightanyx is in full armor.
But if we make Knightanyx super angry,|his hairs will burn even more from anger!
When his hairs are burning with|golden flames his amor will become|to hot.
He will need to remove his helmet|and that will make him vulnerable!
Great work! Now you made him angry!|He removed his helmet!
Wait for his energy to be weak|and use that special discatch!
You actually|were able to catch Knightanyx?
Knightanyx only serves the Golden Elite.|So I guess that means...
You, the boy have earned yourself the title of the. . .
GOLDEN ELITE!
Congratulations! Golden Elite.|Make Knightanyx proud as his new master!
Together you the Golden Elite and me,|we can stop Boris and SUMSUM!
This won't work, Knightanyx is too powerful.|We must wait and use special discatch
No, not yet. It is not weak enough, it will only fail.
Now is your chance,|use the special discatch to capture Knightanyx!
Finally I am awake again! I think I slept|for a full day after eating that pie.
I am so thirsty! I would drink anything right now!
Wow there is a bar in this room!|Look at all those drinks!
What are you doing here?|How were you able to get past Knightanyx?
Oh sorry. I mean welcome to SUMSUM's bar.
All that fighting makes us all thirsty|I will give you the first one for free!
Really? Can I have a free drink here?
Out of my way Ferguson!|The chef is giving away free first drinks!
This special drink is amazing!|It was the best drink I ever had!
Ferguson, here is your first free drink.
Thanks Chef Bernardo. I am so thirsty|and this drink looks so good!
No Ferguson! Stop!|Don't drink it!
What is wrong Dr. Swan?|Why can't I drink it?
I recognize the smell that is coming|from that special drink.
ZZZZZZzzzzzz......
Look there is Chuk! He fell asleep after|drinking the special drink from the Chef.
ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZzzzzzz......
The drink contains the cherry blossom flower!
If you would drink it, you would fall asleep!
Cherry blossom flower in a drink...|Dr. Swan! I just got an idea!
I think we can make a new special|discatch with 4 of those drinks!
Ferguson you are a genius!
Look that guard over there also|got a drink from the Chef.
Get lost! This free drink is mine!
But that free drink was mine!|Now I need to pay to get a second drink.
Great work! Now we already|have 2 special drinks.
This Chef over here was so|kind to give me a free drink.
No Dom! Watch out this|drink will make you...
What is this drink? This drink smells way too sweet.
My old teeth can't handle sweet drinks|anymore. You can have this drink!
That was a close one. Luckily Dom did not drink it.
Now we only need 1 more special drink!
I was trying to find my house.|But I ended up in this room.
Could you point me into the direction of my house?
Helga, how did you get here?|Your house is located in the Christmas Town.
Thank you for pointing me into|the direction of my house.
You can have my free drink that I got|from this kind man with the white hat.
Thank you so much Helga.
We did it! We got 4 special drinks!
Meet me at the end of the bar|and I will make the special discatch.
It is time to try out the theory from Ferguson|to make a special discatch from those|4 special drinks.
Ferguson! You are a genius!|Your theory worked again!
hahah maybe some day|I can become a professor!
This special discath will allow us to|stop any infected by hate Dynamon!
You are not a pro player yet. Only a pro|player would win this challenge!
Wow that was epic! So you really are a|pro player! You have earned my respect.
You may now be called the Golden Elite, but|you will lose the battle against SUMSUM!
I will explain why...
The problem is not your battle skills.|But your battle outfit!
SUMSUM will be able to put a spell|on you and you will lose the battle!
Klaude is right! If only we could block|SUMSUM's spell somehow.
Dr. Swan. I think I have an idea!
I know someone who can help us to make|spell protection suit against SUMSUM.
I will fetch him now!| But please protect me against this guard!
Stop it there Ferguson!|I won't let you get away!
Oh no! That Ferguson guy escaped! Please|don't tell Boris that I let him get away.
I did it! I was able to get the|Scientist here!
Ferguson explained to me that you need|something to block SUMSUM's evil spell.
I think I can create a suit with a|special helmet that will protect the boy.
He is no longer called the boy, but the Golden Elite!
Golden Elite? That is just perfect! Gold is|exactly the material I need to use for the suit.
Mister Scientist, I have something important to|say about the Golden Elite suit!
Knightanyx is wearing the suit from the previous|Golden Elite that passed away a long time ago.
Dom, what are you suggesting|about the Golden Elite suit?
We should not upset Knightanyx. Maybe you|can make a new Golden Elite 2.0 suit!
And the suit needs to look|more powerful and feared!
Got it! I will design it on|a blueprint now!
I did it! I just made the blueprint design|for the new Golden Elite suit!
I present to you all...|the new Golden Elite suit!
I will go to my laboratory now and start working on it!
Proof that you are a legend and win|this legendary prize!
My Master SUMSUM gave me a very|important task! I will not fail him!
